messages:
anya: Dry-run for promo to eu-west failed with a values merge error on 'edgezone' overlay. deploy-bot shows payments.retryCount as string vs int. Can someone take?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DRY-RUN FAILED
service payments: helm template error: overlay key payments.retryCount has conflicting types ("3" vs 3)
Command: helm upgrade --install payments ./charts/payments --dry-run --values values/eu.yaml --values overlays/edgezone.yaml
Logs: http://ci.internal/DRY-9001

sam: Ugh, classic. Short-term: pin payments chart to 1.5.0 and run a small canary. Long-term: add a values schema and normalize overlay types.

anya: Pin seems safest for tonight's release window. Who can push the pin?

sam: I'll open a quick PR changing chartVersion in overlays/edgezone/Kustomization to 1.5.0 and add a note.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR merged, starting canary payments@1.5.0 at 5% (CAN-9001).

ops-bot: k8s: canary pods x3 started, ready 3/3. Recommend 15m observation before traffic bump.

anya: Drafting release note: "Temporarily pinned payments chart to 1.5.0 due to values type mismatch in edgezone overlay; follow-up hotpatch to normalize payments.retryCount to integer and add schema validation."

ops-bot: canary @15m: readiness 100%, errors 0.0%, p95 latency unchanged.

sam: Bump to 50% now. deploy-bot: route-canary CAN-9001 set-traffic 50%

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic updated to 50% for CAN-9001.

ops-bot: 50% steady at 10m. No regressions.

anya: Promote to 100% in 10m if stable.

sam: promoting. deploy-bot: promote CAN-9001

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted CAN-9001 to stable payments@1.5.0. Notifying release-notes-bot.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Added entry 2024-11-25: "Pinned payments chart to 1.5.0 to avoid overlay values type drift; hotpatch scheduled."

ops-bot: prod rollout finished. pods ready 6/6. No alerts.

anya: Closing thread once notes link posted.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: https://releases.internal/notes/2024-11-25/payments-overlay-pin
